comment: Partitioned writes Krishiv and Spark 4.2.0 both make, and Spark reads back (P2-T082b acceptance). Each case: the query written, its partition columns, the file format and options, and an optional second write (`then`: an append or an overwrite). tests/scripts/gen_partitioned_write_goldens.py writes each case with Krishiv (write-partition-cases) and with Spark, and records Spark's directories and Spark's read of Krishiv's output in tests/fixtures/spark-4.2.0/partitioned-write-goldens.json. Both sessions run in UTC.

cases.query: SELECT id, CAST(id % 3 AS INT) AS p FROM range(0, 9)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, DATE '2024-02-29'), (2, DATE '1999-12-31'), (3, CAST(NULL AS DATE)) AS t(id, d)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, 'x', 1), (2, 'x', 2), (3, 'y', 1), (4, 'y', NULL) AS t(id, a, b)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, CAST(1.50 AS DECIMAL(5,2))), (2, CAST(-0.25 AS DECIMAL(5,2))) AS t(id, p)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, true), (2, false) AS t(id, p)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, 'one', 'a'), (2, 'two', 'b') AS t(id, s, p)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, 'one', 10), (2, 'two', 20) AS t(id, s, p)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05'), (2, TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05.123456'), (3, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)) AS t(id, ts)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, CAST('NaN' AS DOUBLE)), (2, CAST(-0.0 AS DOUBLE)), (3, CAST(1.5 AS DOUBLE)) AS t(id, p)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, 10000000000L), (2, -3L) AS t(id, p)
SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b') AS t(id, p)

then.query: SELECT * FROM VALUES (3, 'b'), (4, 'c') AS t(id, p)

cases.query: SELECT * FROM VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b') AS t(id, p)

then.query: SELECT * FROM VALUES (3, 'b'), (4, 'c') AS t(id, p)
